problems.text: Nothing turns kmctl decision candidates' list into a report of unrecorded decisions a user can act on.

goals.text: A user can ask their agent which decisions their history made without a record, and get a report they decide on.

outcomes.change: The decision-gaps skill judges every candidate and reports unrecorded decisions without writing
outcomes.checked_by: tests that the skill folder ships in the package and the wheel, its front matter is valid, its body runs kmctl decision candidates and says it writes nothing, the briefing lists it, the install pages count eight skills; the skill-creator evals kept in evals/ with their results; kmctl check
